analyst_view.overall: Early view: Girona are eighth under Quique Álvarez and strong at home (16 scored, 7 conceded), but they have lost their last two without scoring. Valladolid are 11th and just won their first away game of the season at Sporting, though one preview listed several injuries, including striker Juanmi Latasa. Iván Alejo's ban should be served in round 14.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. Girona's home games average nearly three goals but their attack has stalled lately, and Valladolid's away games average about 2.4, so I stay close to the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners. I lean higher: Girona won seven corners against Almería, and Valladolid are happy to defend deep away (38% possession at Sporting).

cards.text: The numbers say 6.1 cards. Girona took five yellows against Almería and Valladolid three at Sporting, which fits the site's number.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.7 shots. Girona took 14 against Almería and Valladolid 15 at Sporting, so the number looks right.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: Girona managed only three on target against Almería and have not scored in two games.
